source_lineage.note: Extends independently merged original Folio; original archive preserved.

ai_assistance: Implementation, regression design and documentation were AI-assisted; independent parent review is required before merge. No AI/provider generation or external network lookup is added.
limits: No public deployment or production security audit
Linux amd64/Chromium executed; other OS and browser engines not executed
Linear single changed range, not a minimal diff; complete eight-field snapshots included
Selectors: latest 100 plus current/live/chosen; older rows accessible by eight-row pages and exact API revision numbers
Memory-only uncertain restore receipt; refresh/close requires reviewing server history
Restore authority remains owner/draft; read/proposal compare only
Existing approved schedules retain pinned snapshot/time and can publish later
CI result for the exact submitted head must be observed separately; local evidence does not imply remote CI

checks: 36-operation HTTP/CLI/MCP parity; all eight exact fields, source/live metadata, directional review and zero state writes
private-read roles, forbidden restore, anonymous/origin/strict schema/stale/missing guards and Chinese errors
restore retry creates one private revision; current/live/schedule isolation, no-op advisory and intervening-writer CAS
actual committed restore acknowledgement preserves newer typing/caret; subsequent Save uses acknowledged revision
draft-role explicit clean restore copies all eight fields; historical source and same-content duplicate restores stay blocked
paged older history; all eight escaped fields; EN/CN 320/390px and locale preserves selectors/editor/caret
read/proposal Studio roles compare without a restore control; draft restore scope unchanged
comparison excludes unsaved buffer; Restore stays disabled and Cancel preserves unsaved text
18 held real comparison responses: all fields/revert, cancel/Esc/backdrop/command/new/other/lock/back-return and late error
changing comparison while an older response is held preserves the newer selected report
read failure retries the same comparison without writes or editor replacement
six held committed restores: later dialog/edit-revert, exact lost/malformed-ack retry, intervening Agent and cached receipt after failed head check; busy Lock/Back guarded
intervening server writer rejects reviewed stale restoration without replacing the editor
